pov: first-person retrospective narrator / younger experiencing self
purpose: Convert anticipation into delay, irritation, and a late journey whose practical constraints erode the fantasy before arrival.
entry_state: The boy expects to attend Araby on Saturday evening and needs money from his uncle.
desire: Reach Araby before it closes and fulfill the promised gift errand.
conflict: His uncle returns late, domestic waiting consumes the evening, and travel time leaves the bazaar nearly closed.
turn: The long wait ends in a rushed departure, but the trip itself makes the lateness irreversible.
exit_state: The boy reaches the bazaar late with very little time remaining.
forbidden_moves: Do not treat compressed waiting time and narrated duration as equivalent to a single typed world-state change.
style_constraints: Preserve the pressure created by unequal narrative duration across waiting and travel.
